module.Title: Add Player Properties
module.Teaching: Properties expose data on an object. Auto-properties use get and set to read and change values.
module.PredictionExplanation: get returns the property's current value; set allows assignment.
module.DebugPrompt: Add public auto-property syntax, including braces, get, set, and semicolons.
module.RecallPrompt: Add Name and Health properties to Player. Use these exact identifiers: get, set.
module.TransferPrompt: Create a Slime class with an int Health property. Use these exact identifiers: get, set.
module.PreviewMessage: Player objects can now carry name and health properties.
